title: Owners are told to 'Message MettleUp on WhatsApp' with no number or button to do it
what: When branches or entry machines are not ready, or a limit is reached, the admin app says 'Message MettleUp on WhatsApp' but gives no number, link or button. MettleUp's number is only on the website's contact page. The Pro card says something else again: write in Help and feedback. The entry machine guide says 'tell us' with no way to reach anyone.
expected: Every 'contact MettleUp' line opens the same place in one tap: a WhatsApp button to MettleUp's number, or Help and feedback.
how_often: each time one of these messages shows
fix_line: Give every contact line one button that opens MettleUp's WhatsApp or Help and feedback

title: The app promises MettleUp will raise a limit or sort out a machine clash, but MettleUp has no way to do either
what: 'You already have 10 branches... message us if you need more' and 'You can add up to 10 machines... message us' point the owner to MettleUp, but both limits are fixed in the server for every gym; MettleUp cannot raise them for one gym. 'This machine is already added to a gym... we will check it' promises a check, but the HQ app has nothing about entry machines, so the founder would have to dig in the database by hand.
expected: Either MettleUp has a way to raise a limit or free a machine for one gym, or the words do not promise it.
who: owners with many branches or machines, and the founder
fix_line: Add a per-gym limit and a machine look-up to HQ, or change the words

title: A branch can be added but never closed, and leaving MettleUp says nothing about branches
what: An owner can add a branch, open it and rename the business, but there is no way to close or remove one branch, in the app or on the server. The delete request speaks of 'this gym', and the written delete steps for MettleUp never mention branches, so an owner with several branches does not know if one request covers all of them.
expected: An owner can close a branch they no longer run, and the delete request and its steps say what happens to every branch.
who: owners with more than one branch
how_often: when a branch shuts or the owner leaves
fix_line: Add Close a branch, and say in the delete request and its steps which branches it covers

title: Branches are live but have no help article, and the help check cannot see them
what: The All branches page, the branch switcher, adding a branch and checking in a visitor from another branch are live, but no help article covers them, so the help and the AI help cannot answer branch questions. The check that every screen has help only looks at one folder and at files named like screens, so it never noticed.
expected: A help article on branches, and the help check covers the branch pages.
who: owners with more than one branch
fix_line: Write a branches help article and widen the help check to the branch pages

title: Someone trying the demo gym has no way to ask MettleUp a question
what: In the demo gym, Help and feedback is switched off ('This works in your own gym'), and the only link in the demo bar is 'Leave the demo'. A gym owner who is curious has no WhatsApp, phone or form to reach MettleUp from inside the demo.
expected: The demo shows a one-tap way to talk to MettleUp, like a WhatsApp button.
fix_line: Add a Talk to MettleUp WhatsApp button to the demo bar and the switched-off Help page

title: One secret key locks every gym's payment company keys, with no second key and no written way back
what: Each gym's Razorpay or Cashfree keys are locked with one MettleUp secret key kept on the server. There is no second key and no way to change it, and no written record of where a copy is kept. Cloudflare does not show a saved secret again. If that key is lost or replaced, every gym's payment connection stops working and each owner must connect again.
expected: A written, safe copy of the key outside the laptop, and a way to change it without breaking every gym.
how_often: once, if the key is lost
fix_line: Write down where the key's copy lives, and let the server accept an old and a new key

title: The old address on the founder's personal domain must work for good, but nothing records when the domains run out
what: The old admin address sits on the founder's personal domain and is kept for good, for old phones and printed posters. The new address and the entry machine address are on mettleup.fit. Nothing written says when either domain must be renewed or who renews it; if the personal domain lapses, old phones and posters stop reaching the gym server. The entry machine address is still 'to be agreed'.
expected: A written list of both domains with their renewal dates, auto-renew on, and the entry machine address fixed.
fix_line: Write both domains, their renewal dates and auto-renew into the setup notes

title: The entry machine guide says 'the address MettleUp gives you', but the screen writes the address in
what: The written machine set-up guide tells the owner to wait for MettleUp to give them a server address. The app's own set-up steps already show the address. An owner reading the guide waits for a message that never comes.
expected: The guide names the address, or says it is shown on the Entry machines page.
fix_line: Say in the guide that the address is on the Entry machines page
